defects: At 64 inches the structure reads as a small leafy platform, not a Verdant nursery or workshop.
The central trunk and ochre seed pods are too small or occluded to identify in the settlement, opposite, and side views.
The front work bay and ladder collapse into the platform outline at gameplay distance.
Close foliage is broad and pale; dark plum undersides and material contrast do not survive the Room A lighting.
hard_fail_reasons: Luna pixel review rates the gameplay-distance transfer as backlog: in the 1280x720 settlement capture the subject occupies only about x=560-700, y=330-440 and does not read as a nursery/workshop.
The trunk, pods, work-bay opening, and ladder are not distinct in the 64-inch production views.
incumbent_comparison: First dimension-correct candidate for the revised low/broad target. Godot validates 23.26 x 9.44 x 16.84 inches against the 26 x 10 x 18 inch Room A site, but the 64-inch production captures lose the nursery identity and work function.
next_action_hypothesis: Keep the proven 26 x 10 x 18 inch fit. Reduce overlapping leaf coverage, leave a clear view through to a wider dark central trunk, bring several larger ochre pods onto the front-facing branches, and darken the green, plum, and rootwood materials so the trunk, pod clusters, and open bay survive the 64-inch Room A camera.

observations.art_direction_fit: The living root platform and broad foliage remain Verdant, but the burgundy underside, large hanging pods, and cultivated-tree silhouette from the target are not prominent at gameplay distance.
observations.close_up_quality: The platform and ladder are clear in the close view, while the central trunk is weak, hanging pods are faint, and broad leaves still read as paddles.
observations.gameplay_readability: Luna pixel review: the 64-inch subject occupies approximately x=560-700, y=330-440 in the 1280x720 settlement view and reads as a small leafy platform. Opposite and side views show the same information loss.
observations.geometric_detail: At close range the platform slats, roots, ladder rungs, and shaped leaves are visible. At the actual 64-inch camera, the trunk, pods, and open bay collapse into the silhouette.
observations.material_realism: The solid wood and leaf materials are distinct in the source mesh, but Room A lighting makes the leaves pale lime and washes out the warm surfaces. Plum undersides are not visible in the first read.
observations.proportion: The candidate now uses the low/broad room proportions and passes the source fit gate at 23.26 x 9.44 x 16.84 inches. The work surface and access approach still have too little screen presence.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot 4.7.2 technical validation passes with source bounds 23.2637 x 9.4390 x 16.8384 inches against the brief 26 x 10 x 18 inches; all dimension ratios are within the 20% tolerance.
observations.semantic_recognizability: Luna reports a small leafy platform at 64 inches rather than a nursery or workshop; close view restores the assembled platform but not the tree-work function.
observations.silhouette_quality: The settlement, opposite, and side angles show a low foliage patch over a platform. Branch and trunk silhouette do not separate from the leaf canopy.
observations.surface_variation: Close view shows separate materials and modeled veins, but the gameplay capture compresses the palette to bright green with tiny ochre points.
observations.technical_integration: The review-only candidate registry resolves verdant_nursery-v002 in the actual Room A production scene. Nine Godot 4.7.2 captures were registered; no simulation or RoomDefinition data changed.

close_inspection.evidence: In the close and profile renders, broad leaves dominate; the trunk is weak and the ochre seed pods are faint. Luna also finds the front bay and ladder unreadable at 64 inches.

edge_treatment.evidence: Leaf edges and bark roots have modeled thickness and rounded transitions in the close capture.

hardware.evidence: This living structure requires no metal hardware; the wooden platform and ladder are joined with shaped rootwood members.

joins.evidence: Root strands, branch forks, and platform members are visibly assembled, but the main trunk-to-canopy join is obscured.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: Platform slats and ladder rungs are modeled, but the essential nursery cues—trunk, pod clusters, and open work bay—do not read in the registered settlement-scale views.

material_response.evidence: Separate leaf, plum, pod, and rootwood materials exist, but the 64-inch Room A view washes them toward pale green and tan.

surface_variation.evidence: Modeled leaf veins and material surfaces appear close up, but contrast is too weak to survive at settlement scale.

thickness.evidence: Individual leaves have geometric thickness, though their broad paddles read almost flat from the close three-quarter camera.

neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: The close capture shows an intentionally assembled stylized miniature structure with a platform, roots, ladder, and shaped foliage rather than placeholder primitives.

photo_character.evidence: The ArtBrief has no photo reference or source-resemblance requirement.

visual_transfer_diagnosis.corrective_action: Keep the passing envelope and revise the foliage composition: open a clear central sightline onto a wider dark trunk, use fewer overlapping leaves with some front-pitched plum undersides, enlarge and lower several ochre pod clusters on camera-facing branches, and darken the green/rootwood materials for the actual Room A lighting. Simplify the entry ladder/platform outline so it remains distinct at 64 inches.
lost_visual_information: The central trunk is hidden by overlapping foliage in all three settlement-scale views.
Ochre seed pods reduce to tiny pale dots and do not read as harvested seed clusters.
The front work-bay opening and access ladder collapse into the platform outline.
The target plum leaf undersides and dark living rootwood are largely absent from the first gameplay read.
preserved_components: The candidate passes the 26 x 10 x 18 inch source-proportion gate.
A raised work platform, open approach, ladder, branching roots, thick modeled leaves, and seed pods are present in the close geometry.
Candidate loading uses the production Room A resolver and review-only registry.
